description_good_justification: The README opens with what the tool does and the questions it answers: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit#readme
interact_justification: The README explains how to download, verify and run the tool. Bug reports and feature requests go to GitHub issues, and CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to contribute: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to report bugs and propose changes through issues and pull requests against main: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the design rules, the test policy and the style a contribution must follow: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#design-rules
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT License is approved by the Open Source Initiative.
documentation_basics_justification: The README covers installation, release verification, usage, every option, what each check covers, the design principles and the limitations: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit#readme
documentation_interface_justification: The README documents every command-line option, the JSON report and the exit codes: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit#options
sites_https_justification: The project site, repository and downloads are all on GitHub over HTTPS.
english_justification: Documentation and tool output are in English, and bug reports are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: Actively developed, with 17 releases since 2026-11-01. Dependabot and CodeQL also run every week.
repo_track_justification: Git records who made each change and when.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is pushed to main between releases, not only release snapshots.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version tag, such as v0.1.17.
version_tags_justification: Each release is a git tag: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md summarizes the changes in every release, and the release workflow publishes each version's section as its GitHub release notes: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE or similar identifier has been assigned to a vulnerability in this project.
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported in GitHub issues, as CONTRIBUTING.md explains: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/issues
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been filed yet. The maintainer watches the issue tracker and acknowledges reports.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been filed yet. CONTRIBUTING.md asks for new checks to start as issues, which the maintainer answers.
report_archive_justification: Reports and responses stay public and searchable in GitHub issues: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md explains how to report a vulnerability: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received yet. SECURITY.md commits to an acknowledgement within 7 days.
build_justification: make build, or go build with CGO_ENABLED=0 and GOOS=linux. GitHub Actions builds the releases: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/Makefile
build_floss_tools_justification: Builds with the Go toolchain (BSD license) and GNU make only.
test_justification: Unit tests (make test, go test ./...), an end-to-end suite that boots each Ubuntu release in Docker (make e2e) and fuzz tests (make fuzz), all in the repository and documented in the README and CONTRIBUTING.md.
test_invocation_justification: go test ./... (make test runs it in the golang image).
test_most_justification: Unit tests cover 45% of statements. Code that reads the live host is exercised by the end-to-end suite on all five Ubuntu releases instead.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs go vet, the unit tests and govulncheck on every push and pull request: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/actions
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests with every change in behavior: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes add tests, for example https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/a2bb212 and https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/bc12010
warnings_justification: go vet runs on every push and pull request, and CodeQL scans the code.
warnings_fixed_justification: go vet is clean. CodeQL alerts are fixed or dismissed with a stated reason.
warnings_strict_justification: go vet runs with its default analyzers, plus CodeQL. No stricter linter such as staticcheck yet.
crypto_published_justification: Only published algorithms and protocols from Go's standard library: TLS, SHA-256, and MD5 for dpkg compatibility. Releases carry Sigstore attestations.
crypto_call_justification: All cryptography comes from Go's standard library; the project implements none.
crypto_floss_justification: Go's standard library is FLOSS (BSD license).
crypto_keylength_justification: The tool generates no keys. TLS uses Go's defaults, with TLS 1.2 or later for downloads.
crypto_working_justification: MD5 is used only to compare files with dpkg's md5sums, which record no other hash, so the interoperability exception applies. Downloads use TLS 1.2 or later with certificate verification. The TLS default-certificate probe accepts any certificate on purpose: it only reads the certificate a scanner would get and sends no data.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Downloads use TLS 1.2 or later with certificate verification. MD5 is used only for compatibility with dpkg's md5sums, as explained under crypto_working.
crypto_pfs_justification: Go's TLS client negotiates ECDHE key exchange, which provides perfect forward secrecy.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The tool stores no passwords. Password hashes read from /etc/shadow are discarded on reading.
crypto_random_justification: The tool generates no keys or nonces itself; Go's TLS uses crypto/rand.
delivery_mitm_justification: Binaries are downloaded over HTTPS from GitHub Releases, with SHA256SUMS and Sigstore build provenance attestations that gh attestation verify checks.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Hashes are fetched over HTTPS only, and the signed attestation verifies each binary.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched vulnerabilities. govulncheck gates every build, and Dependabot proposes dependency updates.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Fixes ship as new releases. No critical vulnerability has been reported.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository holds no credentials. Workflows use only the GITHUB_TOKEN GitHub provides.
static_analysis_justification: go vet, CodeQL and govulncheck run on every push and pull request, so on every release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security queries and govulncheck look for common vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL's integer conversion findings were fixed: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/a2bb212
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request, and CodeQL also weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Go native fuzzing (make fuzz) of the parsers of host content, and an end-to-end suite that runs the tool under strace to confirm it executes nothing and writes nothing.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Go is memory-safe, CGO is off and the code does not import unsafe.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The fuzz targets assert properties, such as the ordering laws of both version comparisons and that Sanitize leaves no control characters.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Three bugs found by fuzzing were fixed: https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/a995ce9, https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/5c4c9d5 and https://github.com/guanting112/ubuntu-sys-audit/commit/bc12010
